flags.text: "Add inline citation badges by matching each `AssistantCitation` title to the answer text, retaining unmatched citations in the numbered sources list." - Although #233 initially added these badges, #244 removed that implementation during the Markdown integration and deferred inline badges. They were subsequently reintroduced by #245 over sanitized Markdown. Presenting #233 as a separate addition in this changelog misstates what survived integration.

"The badge number matches the Sources list, and citations without a matching title remain listed there." - PR #245 says unanchored citations remain in the Sources list, but does not establish that citations with inline badges also appear there. Its numbered-list consistency claim does not establish that all citations remain listed.

"When a ticket has an actionable suggestion, its first suggested step appears as a primary button or owner picker" - PR #237 says actionable steps are ordered first, but the primary control depends on the action: a status change gets a button and assignment gets an agent picker. The wording implies any actionable suggestion produces either control without that qualification.

"the product now tells the assistant and autonomous worker to check a draft against them before streaming an answer" - PR #218 says the check is enforced through `tool_choice`, not merely requested. Describing the change as telling them to check understates the mechanism that was added.
